tech.headline: LIFE.HELP සමඟ එක්ව කටයුතු කිරීමට දක්ෂ කාර්මිකයින් සාදරයෙන් පිළිගනිමු.
tech.subheadline: දුරකථන අංකයෙන් පහසුවෙන් ලියාපදිංචි වී කොන්ත්‍රාත්තුව අත්සන් කර নම්‍යශීලීව වැඩ කරන්න.
tech.signInDesc: ජංගම දුරකථන අංකය තහවුරු කිරීමෙන් පහසුවෙන් පිවිසෙන්න.

tech.codeSentSuccess: වෙත තහවුරු කිරීමේ කේතයක් යවා ඇත.

privacy.title: පෞද්ගලිකත්ව ආරක්ෂණ නිවේදනය
privacy.content: පාරිභෝගික රහස්‍යභාවය සුරැකීම සඳහා ඔබගේ නම, ලිපිනය සහ දුරකථන අංකය අප වෙනම ගබඩා කර නොගනී. ඔබගේ දුරකථන අංකය 050 තාවකාලික අංකයකට පරිවර්තනය කර කාර්මිකයාට ලබා දෙන අතර සතියකට පසු එය ස්වයංක්‍රීයව අවලංගු වේ. භාවිත ඉතිහාසය ඔබගේ දුරකථනයේ පමණක් සුරැකේ.

chat.title: කොරියාවේ එදිනෙදා ජීවන සේවාවන් ඔබගේ භාෂාවෙන්ම පහසුවෙන් Live Chat
chat.tag: 1:1 Live Professional Consultation in Native Language
chat.desc: Fast and friendly native language consultation service for foreign residents in Korea.
chat.allDutyNotice: {count} total counselors on duty. Leave a message and you will be connected immediately.
chat.startDesc: Describe your inquiry in your preferred language, and an expert counselor will be assigned immediately.
chat.langHint: Can be changed in the top right language menu
chat.inquiryLabel: Inquiry Details or Living Assistance Needed
chat.inquiryPlaceholder: e.g., Blocked drainage needing urgent plumber / Housing lease contract / Boiler repair
chat.guide1: Covers all living issues in Korea: plumbing, repair, house hunting, cleaning, etc.
chat.guide2: Communicate comfortably in your native language.
chat.guide3: Directly match with verified master helpers in your local area.
chat.counselorRecruit: Are you a professional multilingual counselor?
chat.counselorRecruitDesc: Register easily with your mobile number to start counseling foreign residents.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Type your message in English or Korean...
chat.closedNotice: This consultation has ended. Please start a new session for further inquiries.
chat.loginDesc: Receive an SMS verification code with your phone number and begin your shift immediately.
chat.registerDesc: Register your profile and languages to get instantly verified and start taking shifts.
chat.counselorNamePlaceholder: e.g., John Miller, Nguyen Thi Huong, Wang Wei
chat.specialtyPlaceholder: e.g., 3 years living interpretation, TOPIK Level 6, Real estate specialist
chat.agreeLabel: I agree to counselor operational regulations and privacy policy.
chat.replyPlaceholder: Type your response to the customer...
chat.emptyWorkspace: Select an active chat or accept a waiting request from the left list.
chat.emptyWorkspaceSub: Respond to customer inquiries in their native language and match appropriate services.
chat.quickHelloText: Hello! I am your LIFE.HELP counselor. How can I help you today?
chat.quickTechText: Location confirmed. We will assign a verified LIFE.HELP expert helper to your location shortly.
chat.quickHousingText: I will guide you through finding a home and key precautions for rental lease agreements.
